280: ]]

283: Higher is faster, representing more attacks performed in the same amount of time.
284: ]]
285: TOOLTIP_COMBAT_RANGE = _t[[#GOLD#Firing range#LAST#

287: ]]

291: ]]
292: TOOLTIP_COMBAT_AMMO = _t[[#GOLD#Ammo remaining#LAST#
293: This is the amount of ammunition you have left.
294: Bows and slings must be reloaded when this reaches 0, which you will do automatically each turn you rest or don't perform a non-movement action.
295: Alchemists use specially prepared gems as ammunition to throw bombs, which must be reloaded manually.
296: ]]

304: Not all talents are affected; notably, Wild Gifts are not.
305: ]]

310: ]]
311: TOOLTIP_ARMOR_HARDINESS = _t[[#GOLD#Armour Hardiness#LAST#
312: Armour hardiness represents how much of each incoming blows the armour will affect.
313: Absorbs (hardiness)% of incoming weapon damage, up to a maximum of (armour) damage absorbed.
314: ]]
315: TOOLTIP_CRIT_REDUCTION = _t[[#GOLD#Crit Reduction#LAST#
316: Crit reduction reduces the chance an opponent has of landing a critical strike with a melee or ranged attack.
317: ]]
318: TOOLTIP_CRIT_SHRUG = _t[[#GOLD#Crits Shrug Off#LAST#

320: ]]
321: TOOLTIP_DEFENSE = _t[[#GOLD#Defense#LAST#

323: ]]
324: TOOLTIP_RDEFENSE = _t[[#GOLD#Ranged Defense#LAST#

326: ]]
327: TOOLTIP_SAVES = _t[[#GOLD#Saves#LAST#
328: Saving throws represent your ability to shrug off, partially or fully, detrimental effects applied to you.  Most detrimental effects will check their power (physical, spell, mental) vs your corresponding save type to determine if they take effect or not. 90: TOOLTIP_POSITIVE = _t[[#GOLD#Positive Energy#LAST#

92: ]]

96: ]]

98: TOOLTIP_VIM = _t[[#GOLD#Vim#LAST#
99: Vim represents the amount of life energy you control. Each corruption talent requires some.
100: It does not regenerate naturally; you need to drain it from yourself or your victims.
101: Each time you kill a creature you gain 50% of your Willpower + 1 as Vim.  This value is multiplied by the rank of the creature.
102: If you can't pay for the Vim cost of a talent you may instead pay with life at a rate of 200% of the Vim cost.
103: ]]
104: 
105: TOOLTIP_EQUILIBRIUM = _t[[#GOLD#Equilibrium#LAST#
106: Equilibrium reflects your standing in the grand balance of nature and how easily you can access Wild Gifts.
107: The closer it is to 0 the more in-balance you are.
108: Being too far out of balance may cause your Wild Gifts to fail when called upon.
109: ]]
110: 
111: TOOLTIP_HATE = _t[[#GOLD#Hate#LAST#
112: Hate represents your inner rage against all that lives and dares face you.
113: It is replenished by killing creatures and through the application of your talents.
114: All afflicted talents are based on Hate, and many are more effective at higher levels of hate.
115: ]]
116: 
117: TOOLTIP_PARADOX = _t[[#GOLD#Paradox#LAST#
118: Paradox represents how stable the current timeline is. 
119: As your Paradox grows so does your Spellpower, but you may be shifted to a more stable timeline when you attempt to use your magic.
120: When your modified Paradox is above 600 the shifts will become more violent.
121: Your control over chronomancy spells increases with your Willpower.
122: ]]
123: 
124: TOOLTIP_PSI = _t[[#GOLD#Psi#LAST#
125: Psi represents how much energy your mind can harness. Like matter, it can be neither created nor destroyed.
126: It regenerates naturally, though slowly, as you pull minute amounts of heat and kinetic energy from your surroundings.
127: To get meaningful amounts back in combat, you must absorb it through shields or various other talents.
128: Your capacity for storing energy is determined by your Willpower.
129: ]]
130: 
131: TOOLTIP_FEEDBACK = _t[[#GOLD#Feedback#LAST#
132: Feedback represents using pain as a means of psionic grounding and it can be used to power feedback abilities.
133: Feedback decays at the rate of 10% or 1 per turn (which ever is greater) depending on talents.
134: All damage you take from an outside source will increase your Feedback based on to how much of your health is lost and your level.  First level characters gain 100 Feedback when losing 50% health, while 50th level characters gain the same amount when losing 20% health.
135: ]]
136: 
137: TOOLTIP_NECROTIC_AURA = _t[[#GOLD#Necrotic Aura#LAST#
138: Represents the raw materials for creating undead minions.
139: It increases each time you or your minions kill something that is inside the aura radius.
140: ]]
141: 
142: TOOLTIP_FORTRESS_ENERGY = _t[[#GOLD#Fortress Energy#LAST#
143: The energy of the Sher'Tul Fortress. It is replenished by transmogrifying items and used to power all the Fortress systems.
144: ]]
145: 
146: TOOLTIP_LEVEL = _t[[#GOLD#Level and experience#LAST#
147: Each time you kill a creature that is over your own level - 5 you gain some experience.
148: When you reach enough experience you advance to the next level. There is a maximum of 50 levels you can gain.
149: Each time you level you gain stat and talent points to use to improve your character.
150: ]]
151: 
152: TOOLTIP_ENCUMBERED = _t[[#GOLD#Encumbrance#LAST#
153: Each object you carry has an encumbrance value. Your maximum carrying capacity is determined by your strength.
154: You cannot move while encumbered; drop some items.
155: ]]
156: 
157: -------------------------------------------------------------
158: -- Talents
159: -------------------------------------------------------------
160: TOOLTIP_INSCRIPTIONS = _t[[#GOLD#Inscriptions#LAST#
161: The people of Eyal have found a way to create herbal infusions and runes that can be inscribed on the skin of a creature.  More exotic types of inscriptions also exist.
162: Those inscriptions give the bearer always-accessible powers that can be used an unlimited number of times.
163: A simple regeneration infusion is the most common type of infusion, and the use of runes of various types is also common among arcane users.
164: ]]
165: 
166: TOOLTIP_PRODIGIES = _t[[#GOLD#Prodigies#LAST#
167: Prodigies are special talents that only the most powerful of characters can acquire.
168: All of them require at least 50 in a core stat and many also have other, very specific and/or demanding requirements to learn.
169: Players can learn new prodigies at levels 30 and 42.]]
170: 
171: TOOLTIP_ITEM_TALENTS = _t[[#GOLD#Item Talents#LAST#
172: Some objects bestow additional talents on the wearer or holder.
173: These talents work like normal, learned talents, but are lost if the object granting them is taken off or dropped, even for a moment.]]
174: 
175: TOOLTIP_ACTIVATED = _t[[#GOLD#Activated Talents#LAST#
176: Most talents require activation (i.e. time) to use, and create a specific effect when called upon.
177: Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.]]
178: 
179: TOOLTIP_INSTANT = _t[[#GOLD#Instant Talents#LAST#
180: Some activated talents take no time to use, being activated with but a thought.
181: Unlike most talents, instant talents are never put on cooldown from being stunned, and may be usable when most other talents are not.
182: Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.]]
183:

185: When learned, passive talents permanently alter the user in some way.

187: Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.]]
188:

190: Sustained talents are turned on and left on.
191: While active, a sustained talent produces some effects on the user that stay in effect until the talent is deactivated. Activating most sustained talents require the user to put aside some resources, which become unavailable until the talent is turned off.
192: Deactivating a sustained talent causes it to go on cooldown.
193: Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.]]

#GOLD#Magic#LAST#
Magic defines your character's ability to manipulate the magical energy of the world. It increases your Spellpower, Spell Save, and the effect of spells and other magic items.
translation_snapshot.target:
#GOLD#魔力#LAST#
魔力属性影响你驾驭魔法能量的能力，提升魔力可以提高你的法术强度，提升法术豁免，并提高法术和其他魔法物品的效果。

translation_snapshot.source:
#GOLD#Equilibrium#LAST#
Equilibrium reflects your standing in the grand balance of nature and how easily you can access Wild Gifts.
The closer it is to 0 the more in-balance you are.
Being too far out of balance may cause your Wild Gifts to fail when called upon.
translation_snapshot.target:
#GOLD#失衡值#LAST#
失衡值反映了你在自然大平衡中所处的状态，以及你使用野性系技能的难易程度。
失衡值越接近于0你破坏自然平衡的量越少。
当你的失衡值过高时，你使用野性系技能时可能会失败。

translation_snapshot.source:
#GOLD#Passive Talents#LAST#
When learned, passive talents permanently alter the user in some way.
The effects are always present and are usually not dispellable or removable, though other effects may counteract or negate them.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
translation_snapshot.target:
#GOLD#被动技能#LAST#
当你学会被动技能之后，它会以某种方式永久地改变技能的使用者。
这些效果始终存在，通常不会被解除或移除，但是有些特殊效果可能会抵消或消除它们。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。
